label: IP-based geolocation (ip2location, MaxMind, etc.)
reason: Derived from your network IP — not readable from JavaScript
workaround: Use a VPN or proxy. This is separate from the browser Geolocation API (spoofed via the Geolocation preset below).

label: TLS / JA3 / HTTP2 fingerprint
reason: Network stack — Chrome extensions cannot modify TLS handshakes
workaround: No in-extension fix. Use an external VPN/proxy or a hardened browser profile.

label: Installed font list (layout-based probing)
reason: document.fonts can be aligned to your platform preset; canvas width-measurement probes may still leak
workaround: Enable Font enumeration. Ultimate Stealth turns this on.

label: WebRTC local IP
reason: STUN can expose local IPs unless UDP is blocked at the browser policy level

label: Physical window size vs claimed screen
reason: JS inner/outer/screen values are aligned to your Screen preset; real CSS layout still uses the actual viewport unless you resize the window
workaround: Pick a Screen preset + keep matchMedia enabled. Resize browser window to match for best results.

label: Dedicated / Service Worker contexts
reason: Same-origin dedicated workers receive a navigator bootstrap; module, cross-origin, and service workers may not
workaround: Enable Worker navigator bootstrap. Not 100% — known MV3 limitation.

label: True GPU / driver identity
reason: WebGL vendor/renderer strings are spoofed; GPU timing side-channels are not
workaround: Enable WebGL spoofing + pick a WebGL GPU preset. Timing attacks may still fingerprint hardware.
